chunks: Muhammad ibn Isa, by his chain, from the Righteous Ones (peace be upon them) who said:

You should repeat this supplication on the night of the 23rd of Ramadan, prostrating, standing, and sitting, in every state, and throughout the whole month, whenever it is possible for you and whenever the time presents itself, saying after praising Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and sending blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family):

O Allah, be for your guardian, so-and-so ibn so-and-so, during this hour and every hour, a guardian, a protector, a helper, a proof, a guide, an aid, and a witness, until You settle him in Your earth willingly and grant him enjoyment therein for a long time.

And you should say on the fourth night: O Splitter of the dawn, and Maker of the night as tranquility, and the sun and moon for calculation, O Mighty, O Knowledgeable, O Possessor of Favor and Grace, Strength and Power, Bounty and Bestowal, Kingdom and Honor, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O Allah, O Merciful, O Allah, O Solitary, O One, O Allah, O Manifest, O Hidden, O Living, O, there is no god but You, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, and the Greatness.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the fifth night: O Maker of the night as clothing, and the day as livelihood, and the earth as an expanse, and the mountains as pegs, O Allah, O Conqueror, O Allah, O Compeller, O Allah, O Listener, O Allah, O Near, O Allah, O Answerer, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the sixth night: O Maker of the night and day as two signs, O He who erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible, so that you may seek His bounty and pleasure, O Detailer of every thing with detail, O Generous, O Bestower, O Allah, O Benevolent, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the seventh night: O Extender of the shade, and if You willed, You would have made it stationary and made the sun a proof over it, then You gathered it to Yourself with an easy gathering, O Possessor of Generosity and Grace, Greatness and Blessings, there is no god but You, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Merciful, the Compassionate, there is no god but You, O Holy, O Peace, O Secure, O Guardian, O Mighty, O Compeller, O Supreme, O Allah, O Creator, O Maker, O Fashioner, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the eighth night: O Treasurer of the night in the air, and Treasurer of the light in the sky, and Preventer of the sky from falling upon the earth except by His permission, and Withholder of them both from moving, O Knowledgeable, O Forgiver, O Eternal, O Allah, O Inheritor, O Resurrector of those in the graves, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the ninth night: O Roller of the night over the day, and Roller of the day over the night, O Knowledgeable, O Wise, O Allah, O Lord of Lords, and Master of Masters, there is no god but You, O Nearer to me than the jugular vein, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

And you should say on the tenth night: Praise is for Allah, there is no partner for Him, Praise is for Allah as befits the Nobility of His Face and the Honor of His Majesty, and as He is worthy of it, O Holy, O Light of Holiness, O Praiseworthy, O End of Glorification, O Merciful, O Doer of Mercy, O Knowledgeable, O Great, O Allah, O Subtle, O Majestic, O Allah, O Listener, O Seer, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to You belong the Beautiful Names, the Lofty Examples, the Greatness, and the Blessings.

I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and to make my name among the fortunate in this night, and my soul with the martyrs, and my good deeds in the Illiyyun, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and to please me with what You have apportioned for me, and give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the burning punishment, and grant me remembrance of You, gratitude to You, hope in You, return to You, repentance, and success in what You succeeded Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) in.

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication to recite on the nights of the last ten days of Ramadan according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in *Al-Kafi*, is a cornerstone of Shia devotion during the *Ishraq* (dawn) of the 23rd night of Ramadan, specifically emphasizing the intercession and occultation of Imam al-Mahdi (aj). It structurally combines petitions for the Imam’s presence with personal spiritual refinement, invoking Divine Names to secure certainty (*yaqin*) and forgiveness, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking cosmic order with individual salvation.
